# 4AllPass

> Self-hosted zero-knowledge password manager with local agent credential access.
> Your agents need access. They don't need your secrets.
> Not All Pass Hub. Not the Flutter Allpass app. Not a nicer Bitwarden.

## Front door

| Surface | Role |
|---|---|
| https://netzwerkpunkt.de | Suite home (Hauptseite / in Arbeit). 4AllPass not listed there yet. |
| https://landjunge.github.io/4AllPass/ | Product front + fallback landing |
| https://github.com/landjunge/4AllPass | Source |

## Family (honest status, 2026-08-21)

- 4AllPass — credentials — GitHub source, hub listing pending
- Gnom-Hub-V1 — execution — on the hub: in progress
- Tollgate — network/safety — on the hub: in progress

- Detektivspiel — documentation only
- Meridian — experiment, source only

## Honest limits

- FastAPI never mints tokens. Grants live on the unlocked device.
- There is no n8n marketplace node.
- The server never sees the master password, vault key, or plaintext entries.
- Packages are still `UNLICENSED` until the owner publishes a license.
